September 1, 2026

As investment in artificial intelligence has led to a boom in new data centers across the country, this week's Economist / YouGov Poll finds that many Americans oppose data center construction. About half (51%) of Americans say that the construction of new data centers is a bad thing for the country. Only 20% say it is a good thing while 17% say it is neither a good or bad thing.
results.title: Nearly two-thirds of Americans oppose data center construction in their community

# Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters

David Montgomery-August 18, 2026

According to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll, about one-third (35%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Donald Trump's job performance as president, and 61% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -26, up slightly from -29 last week.
results.title: Republican support for Trump has fallen as Democrats hold a big lead among enthusiastic midterms voters
